rules.name: cs-06-verify-spot-case-dev
rules.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.currency, m.spot AS mapping_spot, u.underlying_id AS price_spot FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = 'CFS')) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot WHERE m.tenant_id = :tenant

SELECT p.curr_mult_factor AS product_value, u.underlying_id AS price_spot, count(*) AS products FROM opera.product_master_table p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT underlying_id FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND value_date = (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = 'CFS')) u ON lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(p.curr_mult_factor) AND u.underlying_id <> p.curr_mult_factor GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT p.invenio_product_code, p.curr_mult_factor, (SELECT max(u.settle_value) FROM opera.underlying_settle_value_table u WHERE u.tenant_id = :tenant AND u.value_date = (SELECT v.value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table v WHERE v.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.business_unit = 'CFS') AND u.underlying_id = p.curr_mult_factor) AS spot_exact FROM opera.product_master_table p WHERE p.invenio_product_code = 'CM CRD'

expect.reason: mapping spot ids match the price table exactly
product curr_mult_factor matches the price table exactly
CM CRD finds its BRL spot (about 5.46)
